cases.name: repeated_noun_without_continuity_need
cases.source_pattern: A term is repeated while the visual identity would not need to persist.

cases.name: important_thesis_without_identity_need
cases.source_pattern: The central thesis returns several times but has no recurring subject or symbolic pattern.
cases.reason: Narrative importance is not continuity importance.

cases.name: concrete_central_subject
cases.source_pattern: The same concrete compared subject returns through direct aliases.
cases.reason: Omitting it would remove a distinct downstream identity requirement.

cases.name: duplicate_side_of_existing_motif
cases.source_pattern: An abstract side label is fully represented by an existing contrast motif.

invariants: Precision is preferred for abstract concepts.
Concrete central subjects are retained when grounded.
Do not create candidates just to make the catalog fuller.
